articles.title: If Passwords Are Hashed, How Do Hackers Still Crack Them?
articles.excerpt: Every few months there's a breach announcement. Some company apologizes, tells users to reset their passwords, and adds, almost reassuringly, that passwords were "stored as hashes." The implication is…
articles.body: Every few months there's a breach announcement. Some company apologizes, tells users to reset their passwords, and adds, almost reassuringly, that passwords were "stored as hashes." The implication is that even though the database was stolen, the passwords themselves are safe. Sometimes that's true. Often it's not. And the reason why gets at something genuinely interesting about how password cracking actually works. What a Hash Actually Is When you create an account and set a password, a well-designed system doesn't store what you typed. It runs your password through a hash function, stores the result, and throws the original away. A hash function takes any input and produces a fixed-length output. Feed it correct-horse-42 and it spits out a string of characters.

articles.title: WINDOW FUNCTIONS,JOINS,SUBQUERIES AND CTEs
articles.excerpt: WINDOW FUNCTION What is a window Function It is a function that performs calculations across a set of rows related to the current one and returns the result of its computation for each row. Unlike GRO…
articles.body: WINDOW FUNCTION What is a window Function It is a function that performs calculations across a set of rows related to the current one and returns the result of its computation for each row. Unlike GROUP BY, Window functions in PostgreSQL do not aggregate values and therefore do not reduce the number of rows in the output dataset. All rows from the input table are present in the output, and computations are attached to the corresponding rows. In other words, you can think of a window function as a computation that for each row requests a value that is the result of some calculation applied to a certain set of rows (a window). The commonly used Window Functions include, ROW_NUMBER() This function is used to retrieve single records out of a repeating table.

articles.title: How We Refactored a 2,400-Line CLI Monolith into 7 Core Verbs Without Breaking Changes
articles.excerpt: As TokenCap expanded from a simple repository snapshot generator to a full intelligence engine with graphs, memory loops, and security scanners, our CLI sprawled out of control. We had 21 distinct com…
articles.body: As TokenCap expanded from a simple repository snapshot generator to a full intelligence engine with graphs, memory loops, and security scanners, our CLI sprawled out of control. We had 21 distinct commands in a single 2,455-line bin/tokencap.js file. To fix this, we completed a major CLI refactoring around 7 core verbs. The 7 Core Verbs Hierarchy make ( src/cli/make.js ): Snapshot generation, watch mode, custom budgeting profiles. ask ( src/cli/ask.js ): Spatial queries ( ask impact , ask dead-code , ask adr ). analyze ( src/cli/analyze.js ): Repo audits ( analyze health , analyze debt , analyze security ). serve ( src/cli/serve.js ): Background daemons ( serve --daemon , serve --mcp ). update ( src/cli/update.js ): In-place upgrades. help & version : System introspection.

articles.title: Deriving a Ghost theme palette from one accent color
articles.excerpt: The constraint: Ghost gives you one color Ghost themes get exactly one brand color from the admin: --ghost-accent-color. That value often needs to carry most of the UI: links, buttons, hovers, subtle…
articles.body: The constraint: Ghost gives you one color Ghost themes get exactly one brand color from the admin: --ghost-accent-color . That value often needs to carry most of the UI: links, buttons, hovers, subtle backgrounds, borders. You can add more theme settings, but it is possible to treat that single accent as the source of truth and derive everything else in CSS. With one custom property in package.json , the theme can generate tints, hover states, borders and soft backgrounds using color-mix() and, where helpful, oklch() . No extra admin fields are required. Starting point: normalize the accent color Ghost exposes the accent color as --ghost-accent-color on :root .

articles.body: Expect to see quite a few websites serving error pages today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild. Image: Shutterstock.com, Sashkin. The flaws at issue are present in PHP , the programming language that powers sites running on a large number of web publishing systems, including Drupal , Magento , Joomla and WordPress . Earlier today, PHP released an emergency security update to fix two critical bugs that can allow an attacker to execute code of their choosing on a vulnerable server.
